headings.usage: Headers, main numerical stats, shift titles.

body.usage: Schedule tables, driver names, tooltips, secondary data.

mono.usage: Time codes (e.g., 05:30 - 11:50), vehicle license plates, ID numbers, driver skill tags.

rules: Use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and shift labels.
Never use Inter or standard system fonts.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) merged with HERA Corporate Identity

primary.name: HERA Environment Green
primary.usage: Primary CTAs (Generate Shifts), active state indicators, completed assignments.

rules: Color is Function Only. 90% of the UI should be monochrome.
Never use pure black or pure white without a subtle tint or border separation.
Use Signal Red (#FF3B30) specifically for uncovered shifts or overlapping conflicts.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Heavy use of 1px borders (border-border/40) everywhere. No soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' ONLY for the Smart Substitution Modal overlay and Sticky Header. backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60 (dark mode) or bg-white/70 (light mode) with a 1px delicate inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.borders: Square or extremely sharp corners. Max border-radius: rounded-sm (2px). Never use fully rounded pills for standard data.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main app background to remove digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 tight gap (gap-px or gap-4).
grids_and_layouts.schedule_matrix: 7-column grid for days of the week. Inside each day, 3 stacked rows for the 3 shifts (Morning Early, Morning Std, Afternoon).
rules: Every pixel must be utilized in the schedule grid. Use h-full to stretch children.
Ensure ample padding (p-4 or p-6) within modal containers.

motion.interactions: Hover: Slight background darkening (hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800). No scaling (no hover:-translate-y-1) for technical data.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out. Never use 'transition: all'.
motion.modals: Smart Substitution Modal must slide up from the bottom (framer-motion y: 50 -> 0) with a quick spring effect.

component_instructions.schedule_board: The core UI. Use a CSS Grid (7 cols) or horizontal scroll on mobile. Each cell represents a day. Inside, stack 3 blocks (Mattino Presto, Mattino Standard, Pomeriggio). If a block is understaffed (e.g., Presto needs 3, has 2), highlight with a dashed red border and a 'Missing' badge.
component_instructions.smart_substitution_modal: A side-drawer or center modal (Crystal Glass). Contains a list of drivers. MUST filter/sort by: Skill match (driver can drive the specific truck/route) and Availability (not already scheduled that day).
component_instructions.skill_matrix: A dense table using Shadcn Table. Rows: Drivers. Columns: Vehicles & Routes. Cells: Custom Checkbox (Shadcn Checkbox customized with HERA Green).
component_instructions.driver_view: Mobile-first approach. Read-only. Stacked cards showing their specific shifts for the next 7 days, highlighting today's/tomorrow's shift. Large typography for time codes.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges, 1px border. Primary button 'Genera Turni' uses HERA Green. Secondary buttons use transparent background with border.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure IBM Plex Sans text on HERA Green primary buttons has sufficient contrast (use white text).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live='polite' for the auto-scheduling engine completion toast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='generate-shifts-btn', data-testid='driver-skill-checkbox').

image_urls.description: Avatar for a male truck driver in the Driver Management and Smart Substitute lists.
Alternative avatar for driver management list.
Subtle, dark-overlaid background for the Admin/Driver Login Page.

libraries.components: shadcn/ui primitives heavily customized (NOTE: Use JavaScript .js / .jsx, do not use TypeScript .tsx)

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic SaaS styling. This is an industrial/enterprise tool for Hera S.p.A. The design should reflect precision and industrial utility.
Use Phosphor Icons for all iconography. Provide installation command if not present.
Enforce 'Grid Borders' style: data tables and schedules should look like Excel or a technical schematic (1px solid lines, no padding between structural sections, highly dense).
Smart Substitution Modal: when rendering driver options, clearly display matching 'Skills' as small mono-font tags.
Never use placehold.it or standard gray avatars. Use the provided image_urls or build initial-based avatars with HERA Green backgrounds.

For the Schedule Board, layout exactly 3 shifts per day: Mattino Presto (05:30-11:50, max 3 drivers), Mattino Standard (06:00-12:20), Pomeriggio (12:30-18:50). Build the logic to enforce the max 3 drivers for Mattino Presto.
Ensure the entire application uses React Javascript (.jsx/.js files), as no TS configuration is expected unless explicitly configured.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use crisp, sharp button styles with interaction animations & HERA Green.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
